title: Single-step Retrosynthesis via Reinforcement Learning from Forward Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2610.15141v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Single-step retrosynthesis is a one-to-many inverse problem, yet most models are trained and evaluated against a single recorded reactant set. Reference-based training gives no explicit positive signal for unrecorded alternatives, and exact-match evaluation rejects non-matching predictions regardless of chemical plausibility. We propose Retrosynthesis via Reinforcement Learning from Forward Feedback (RetroRLFF), which optimizes reactant generation using both reference agreement and forward consistency with the target product. Starting from a supervised decoder-only Transformer, RetroRLFF generates complete reactant candidates and uses a frozen forward reaction model to predict products. A sequence-level reward combines reference agreement and forward consistency while penalizing invalid outputs. Direct Advantage-Based Policy Optimization updates the policy without human preference annotations or a preference-trained reward model. On USPT

translated_title: 基于前向反馈强化学习的单步逆合成方法
translated_abstract: 单步逆合成是一个一对多的逆问题，然而大多数模型仅针对单一已记录的反应物集合进行训练和评估。基于参考答案的训练无法为未记录的替代方案提供明确的正向信号，而精确匹配的评估方式则在不考虑化学合理性的情况下拒绝不匹配的预测。我们提出了基于前向反馈强化学习的逆合成方法（RetroRLFF），该方法利用参考答案一致性和与目标产物的前向一致性来优化反应物生成。从监督训练的仅解码器Transformer出发，RetroRLFF生成完整的反应物候选方案，并使用冻结的前向反应模型来预测产物。序列级别的奖励结合了参考答案一致性和前向一致性，同时对无效输出进行惩罚。直接基于优势的策略优化方法无需人类偏好标注或偏好训练的奖励模型即可更新策略。在USPT（原文截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出RetroRLFF方法，通过将参考答案一致性与前向反应模型的一致性共同作为奖励信号进行强化学习，在无需人类偏好标注的情况下优化单步逆合成的反应物生成，从而解决传统基于参考答案训练无法认可化学上合理的替代反应物方案的问题。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes RetroRLFF, a reinforcement learning approach that optimizes single-step retrosynthesis by combining reference agreement and forward reaction model consistency as reward signals without human preference annotations, addressing the limitation that reference-based training cannot recognize chemically plausible alternative reactant sets.
